scope: One zero-fitting paired impact audit of the frozen support beta versus beta0 on all original motion/start/yield-entry training references. No second LP, coefficient search or simulation.
basis: One shared beta restored all9 selected local LC labels, but7 of9 motion losses worsened and case1198 has a necessary target rear-gap constraint at equality. Before further selected-case estimation, measure effects away from those9 cases.

fixed_inputs.source: The four already recorded1800-second target training paths, original160000-record reservoir manifest, frozen current observations/executors/history priors and original labels.
fixed_inputs.physics: Current discrete braking, entity/conflict/receiving geometry, minimum gaps, start/yield definitions and feature scales remain frozen.

paired_response: For each original focal candidate intent, use exactly its saved prior order/weight and the frozen current background intent realization. Install the focal intent/connection, derive all current-packet canonical38 features from that same predecision state, and apply beta0 or the identical candidate beta to every current packet. Resolve fresh shared longitudinal dependencies with the existing potential start/yield permissions. No observed future enters features or neighbour selection. Other categorical coefficients stay zero. Both arms use the same query order and conditioning.

likelihood.motion: Original untruncated Normal(mu,1) prior mixture, with mu equal to the accepted shared longitudinal response; do not replace it by mu0 plus a score or reject finite Gaussian labels above a physical mean.
likelihood.start: Original start-risk definition and zero-logit Bernoulli probability, rebuilt from each arm's accepted response; outside risk, probability1 for y0 and0 for y1.
likelihood.yield_entry: Original compatible-connection/signal/admissibility/distance risk definition and zero-logit Bernoulli probability, rebuilt from each arm; outside risk, probability1 for y0 and0 for y1.
likelihood.comparison: Use all original reference records as each head's fixed denominator, with original y. Keep risk/retention transitions visible, never remove newly unsupported positive labels. Report infinite NLL explicitly, alongside finite-subset sums with their counts; no three-head quantity is called a complete four-head joint objective.

readouts: Reproduce the cached discrete-braking beta0 reference identities/labels/priors and baseline probabilities under identical conditioning before interpreting candidate differences; mismatch is technical HOLD, not permission to change a comparator.

Per-head and per-seed paired support gains/losses, all-label NLL, finite-subset sums/counts and paired deltas on the finite-in-both subset; motion improved/worsened counts and tail changes. Keep observed speed above the base physical proposal separate from above the accepted mean; neither makes the untruncated Gaussian density zero.
Start/yield positive-label support transitions separately from new permissions for y0; report retained/excluded transitions without changing fixed denominators.
Shared raw-score/clipping/zero-speed-floor frequencies and accepted-response changes on the evaluated queries, including background dependencies; these diagnose saturation, not control performance.

Keep the nine selected local LC results and cached direct-gap readout separate. Do not apply their posthoc direct-denier selection to all40000 LC records, and do not substitute old fixed-stay LC masks for the new sequential marginal law.
completion: Finish the paired three-head training-distribution audit and report the candidate's distribution-wide effects. A newly unsupported label or baseline mismatch blocks further admission until reported; never patch thresholds or reestimate beta within this audit. Even finite/improved training likelihood does not establish independent prediction or source-transfer benefit.
after: Stop after this audit. Full sequential LC requires a separately specified label-independent actor/intent rule; no automatic190-parameter optimizer, support LP, calibration, free rollout or manuscript update.
storage: Run against existing server records on jtl110gpu2; leave feature arrays, detailed reference records and candidate parameters there. Pull only compact JSON summaries and logs.
implementation_boundary: Use general focal-goal shared MotionResolver queries for ordinary/internal/END/cross-road records. The9-case prepare_plan/evaluate_shared API is not applicable wholesale because it requires local actors remain on an ordinary road. Canonical features may be evaluated lazily for every requested dependency from the complete current frame, with query-local caches; no unqueried background actor is assigned residual0 by default.
estimand: Paired accepted-motion and dynamically recomputed risk/permission working readout under identical physics and conditioning. This does not evaluate the old joint optimizer at nonzero beta: its saved start/yield masks were fixed, and its complete190-parameter objective remains unimplemented for this shared sequential model.
